decided_by: maintainer 2026-11-01 'Research A v2: Execute A1 First', Phase A (1)-(2): the calibration's 10 short (profile, cell, mode) closed and state_eval_hybrid@v1 generated natively in both modes
_seed_base: this session's own (a task's seeds are run_battery.request_seed(seed_base, task_id, turn)); every other execution value is the base protocol's

state_evaluation._planning_yield: (natural-termination share, scored positions per terminated task) per (type, mode): build_state_eval_hybrid.yields (the hybrid's calibration records; code from training records); used until 8 tasks of a (type, mode) are generated, then the session's own measured yield
state_evaluation.rule: per mode and type, the type's queue in order while the (type, mode) holds fewer than 12,000 scored positions or fewer than 5 naturally terminated tasks; both modes from the queue's start; a queue that ends short is EXHAUSTED and reported, never filled from another type or mode

calibration.rule: each top-up unit in the modes it is listed for, one candidate; the dev box's profile build takes D4's cell order (build_calibration_supplement.profiles)
